What Are The Steps to Check CBSE Class 12th Compartment Result 2026?

Candidates can follow the steps given below to download the scorecard through the CBSE Class 12th Compartment Result login portal

  • Visit the official website @cbseresults.nic.in or cbse.gov.in
  • Click on the homepage and search for Senior School Certificate Exam (Class XII) Supplementary Result 2026
  • Open the CBSE Class 12th Supplementary Result login page properly
  • Enter the Roll No., School No., Admit Card ID & Date of Birth
  • Fill in the security captcha code & click on Submit
  • See the status of result & scorecard
  • Download & print the CBSE Class 12th Compartment Result PDF for future reference

Candidates who cleared in the CBSE Class 12th Compartment 2026 Result proceed to the further academic procedures given as under

CBSE 12th Compartment Result 2026 FAQs

Ques. Is the CBSE Class 12th Compartment Result 2026 declared?

Answers: Yes the Central Board of Secondary Education has declared the CBSE Class 12th Compartment 2026 Result @cbseresults.nic.in.

Ques. How can candidates download the CBSE 12th Supplementary Result 2026 PDF?

Answers: Go to cbseresults.nic.in or cbse.gov.in, navigate to the Class 12th Supplementary Result link & enter the exam details to download

Ques. What details are needed for Class 12th Compartment Result login?

Answers: Candidates need the Roll No., School No., Admit Card ID & Date of Birth to log in to check the CBSE Class 12th Compartment Result 2026 PDF Download Link

Ques. How many candidates appeared for the Class 12th Supplementary Exam 2026?

Answers: Approximately 1,63,800 students appeared for the CBSE Class 12th compartment exam.

Ques. What is the passing percentage needed in CBSE Class 12th Compartment exam ?

Answers: Candidates need to secure at least 33% aggregate marks separately in theory & practical/internal assessment to pass.

Ques. What is the next stage after qualifying in the CBSE Class 12th Compartment Result 2026?

Answers : Candidates can download the digital marksheet on DigiLocker, get physical marksheets from the schools & go ahead with university/college undergraduate admissions procedures
